research_question: Can actual cross-market event ownership establish a persistent marketwide initiative state whose fresh five-minute MSS/FVG retests create repeated, independent, cost-positive continuation opportunities?

economic_contract.state_source: A fully completed SCDAM FAR/AAC event admitted only when the candidate owns event-direction rank one; AAC additionally requires the quote-notional liquidity leader.
economic_contract.state_invalidation: Completed source-market reacceptance through the swept boundary, declared external target delivery, or a fresh owned transfer.
economic_contract.entry: A fresh completed five-minute displacement breaks a protected swing in the active initiative direction and leaves a strict three-candle FVG; first consequent-encroachment retrace is the passive parent.
economic_contract.stop: Beyond the last opposing five-minute candle or protected swing, with the existing ATR buffer.
economic_contract.target: Next causally confirmed live 4H or previous-day external pool in the initiative direction.
economic_contract.independence: One plan per distinct five-minute displacement identity; one global pending-entry or open-position slot remains unchanged.

claim_rule: These exposed periods are mechanism-development evidence only and can never support a success claim. A different precommitted untouched reservation is mandatory after the logic is frozen.
